description: We are students from Universiti Putra Malaysia (UPM), and we want to take this challenge as part of our study journey. For this chosen challenge, we want to help farmers choose a crop for a specific location, temperature, soil and more for them to make a rotation crop. We hope for the best with this challenge.
summary: The Serumpun application provides environmental information to help farmers understand agricultural conditions, crop vulnerability, and soil health. It displays important data such as temperature, monthly rainfall, soil wetness, and elevation based on the selected location. The application also provides graphs showing monthly averages and rainfall forecasts, allowing users to compare environmental conditions and understand how weather changes may affect crop growth. Besides that, the application has a simple and user friendly interface to help farmers understand the information, even if they have limited technical or geographical knowledge. Data is presented through clear labels, graphs, and maps. Another important feature is the field information and crop recommendation system. Users can enter details about their soil type, soil pH, irrigation availability, field slope, shade, previous crops, and field size. Based on the information provided and the selected month, the application recommends suitable crops with scores out of 100 and suitability levels. This helps farmers identify crops that are more suitable for their field conditions and plan their planting activities. Overall, Serumpun is a useful tool that combines environmental data and field information to support farmers in making better agricultural decisions and improving crop management.
details:
Serumpun is an application designed to provide environmental and agricultural information to help users make better farming decisions. It provides data such as temperature, rainfall, soil wetness, elevation and weather forecasts. Users can also enter their field information, including soil type, water availability, terrain, previous planting history and field size. Based on the information provided, the application analyses the conditions and recommends suitable crops. Users can also view environmental data through maps, graphs and monthly comparisons.

Serumpun offers several benefits, especially for people involved in agriculture. It helps users identify suitable crops based on their land and environmental conditions, making it easier to plan farming activities. The application also makes agricultural information easier to access and understand, saving users time when collecting data. Furthermore, it helps reduce the risk of selecting unsuitable crops and encourages better use of natural resources such as water and land.

The main intended impact of Serumpun is to encourage smarter and more sustainable agricultural practices. By providing environmental information and crop recommendations, the application aims to help users make informed decisions, reduce the risk of crop failure and improve agricultural productivity. In the long term, Serumpun hopes to support better land management, efficient resource usage and more sustainable food production.

Serumpun was developed using tools Electron to create a desktop application. The main programming language used was TypeScript, together with JavaScript, HTML, CSS and JSON. In addition, an AI agent called Work Buddy (LLM HY4) was used to assist with the development process.

Our project, Serumpun, combines environmental data and AI technology to help users make better decisions in agriculture. Instead of relying only on traditional methods, our application provides useful information such as weather conditions, soil wetness, elevation and crop recommendations in one platform. Our team considered several factors when developing this project, including soil conditions, rainfall, temperature, water availability, terrain and land size. We also focused on making the application easy to use and ensuring that the information provided could help users choose suitable crops and plan their farming activities more
